runtime_semantic_function_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.offline_internal_canonical_spki_ed25519_verify(subject_public_key_info_der bytea, canonical_signature_preimage_bytes bytea, signature_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN offline_crypto.canonical_spki_ed25519_verify($1,$2,$3);
END;
$function$

graph_boundary: All15 control relations/19FKs traced including downstream conditional edges; economic identities have no domain SQL FK here and must come from independent input. SQL FK satisfaction is not semantic approval.
causal_order: Verify immutable approval, target, exact role allocation, fixture-1 and complete canonical original/plan/registration input before BEGIN.
BEGIN one reviewed ADMIN transaction; no SET ROLE, grants, repair, UPSERT or function creation.

Insert NOT_READY readiness and fresh ACTIVE preflight key in either order in the same transaction: both mutual FKs INITIALLY DEFERRED. Use canonical nonempty observed history/ACL bytes and actual administrative failed/unqualified watchdog observation, never x01 placeholders.
Insert complete header after readiness exists (header FK1 immediate; fixture-1 already exists).
Insert expected original attestation after header (forward FK and trigger require header immediately; reverse FK deferred to commit).

Insert lifecycle REGISTERED, pointer no attempt/claim false, delivery NOT_CREATED, reconciliation NOT_STARTED and ceremony NONE after header. Same approved positive ADMIN generation in pointer/delivery; no invented default. Four identity slots are already in header.identity_slots, not extra SQL rows.
Validate deferred constraints and full canonical context; commit only complete permitted graph, otherwise rollback all. No activation/READY, execution, admission, effects or diagnostic rows.
